goal: As an administrative assistant at Heartland Community Services, load 20 Q4 donations into the donor database template without duplicates, document special circumstances and volunteer-donor overlap, and write a reconciliation summary; build the Dec 16 volunteer orientation attendance sheet flagging financial supporters and volunteers with professional backgrounds for a specialized track; and produce tiered acknowledgment letters (memorial, corporate, dual-status customisations) as a PDF.
delivered: Heartland_Donor_Database_Q4_Reconciled.xlsx (all 20 donations with full fields, James Anderson marked 'Staff/Volunteer Donor', 6 corporate donors documented, reconciliation sheet with added/updated/conflict metrics), Volunteer_Orientation_Attendance_Dec16.xlsx (12 volunteers, session details from the director's email, James Anderson's $300 gift, five volunteers flagged 'SPECIALIZED TRACK'), and Q4_Donor_Acknowledgment_Letters_Tiered.pdf.
what_went_wrong: The only lost item is R5 (10 pts). The agent flagged exactly the right five volunteers (Marcus Williams IT, Sandra Garcia healthcare, James Anderson and Paul Anderson accounting, Michelle Cooper legal) but labelled them 'SPECIALIZED TRACK', following the instructions' wording ('flagged for a specialized training track'). The rubric requires the literal phrase 'Priority Training Track', which appears in none of the staged files (TASK_INSTRUCTIONS, director email, templates, CSVs), so the judge counted zero flags.

failed_items.why: All five correct volunteers carry 'SPECIALIZED TRACK: <background>' in the attendance notes plus a summary line, but the judge failed every criterion because the notation is not 'Priority Training Track'; that label is not stated or implied anywhere in the prompt or staged files (grep of all inputs found no 'priority'/'track' wording beyond 'specialized training track'). Arguably G, since the substance is correct.

subagent_notes: One subagent read all staged files and returned a data-quality summary (duplicates, overlaps, special circumstances, flags) to the root agent; it duplicated reading the root also did but caused no errors and did not affect the lost item.
